the hematopoietetic stem cell transplantation is a high risk procedure, which requires the nutritional assessment, as well as nutritional therapy to improve patient’s quality of life.

nutritional assessment in patients with hematological malignancies is important to identify malnutrition, and nutritional support is essential for the success of the treatment and the patient’s quality of life.

the Brazilian Nutritional Consessment in Hematopoetic Stem Cell Transplant: Elderly, was elaborated by the nutritionists, nutriologists and hematologist physicians from 15 Brazilian reference centers in hematopoeic stem cell transplantation in order to emphasize nutritional status and body composition during the therapy and to establish the consensus to improve and standardiz the nutritional therapy during hematopoietic Stem cell transplantation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the nutritional status and the nutritional therapy during hematopoietic cell stem transplantation, especially in the elderly.
the nutritional status of the elderly, which is an important factor in the prognosis of the patient.
the importance of nutritional assessment in elderly patients undergoing hematopoietic cell transplantation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
nutritional status is important for hematopoietic cell transplantation and it must be evaluated before the procedure, as well as during the treatment.
the nutritional status of the patient should be evaluated before and after hematopoietic cell transplantation.

the nutritional therapy should be performed in all patients with hematopoietic cell transplantation, with a nutritional assessment, and the nutritional therapy is based on a balanced diet, with the addition of supplements, according to the nutritional requirements.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

nutritional status is a very important factor in the hematopoietetic stem cell transplantation, and the nutritional therapy must be individualized and multidisciplinary, with a close monitoring of patient’s nutritional status.
, the nutritional assessment of the elderly patient should be made by a multidisciplinary team, and it must include the nutritional status and the nutritional requirements.

the elderly patients who will undergo to a Hematopoietics Stem Cell Transplant should have their nutritional status assessed, as well as their body composition, and the nutritional therapy should be individualized, according to the patient’s nutritional needs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
nutritional status and body composition are important factors to be considered in elderly patients undergoing hematopoietic cell transplantation.
the nutritional therapy should start at the pre-transplant phase, in order to prevent nutritional deficiencies, which can lead to a worse prognosis.
the elderly population has specific needs, and it is important to emphasize the nutritional therapy in order to improve their quality of life.
